title: Craigdarroch Castle
geometryBasis: The native named mansion provides the plan. The roof has sampled one-metre building returns and the foundation follows original surveyed ground.
sectionBasis: The exact exterior photograph shows the round stair tower and balcony, red slate, carved dormers, flanking stone chimneys and arched carriage entrance. The national designation identifies the masonry and roof materials, the openings and preserved balconies.
limitations: Small carving, decorative ironwork and areas away from the documented elevation are approximated. The tallest finial is narrower than the survey grid and is estimated.
The model is the exterior of the mansion. The interior, grounds and outbuildings are outside the model scope.

dimensions.roofDatum: Open LidarBC surface samples as measured above the original approach
